title: Synthesis, characterization, in vitro and computational assessment of new xanthene hydrazone derivatives as promising vasorelaxant agents
content:

Mohammed El Mesky, Ismail bouadid, Fatimazahra Guerguer, Hicham Zgueni, Yassine Rhazi, Mohammed Chalkha, Farid Khallouki, Samir Chtita, Sahar Abdulaziz AlSedairy, Mourad A. M. Aboul-Soud, John P. Giesy, Driss Chebabe, El Houssine Mabrouk, Mohamed Eddouks
This article reports the synthesis of novel xanthene-hydrazone derivatives, their structural characterization, and the evaluation of their vasorelaxant properties using both in vitro and in silico approaches.
